Morning pastries (croissants, scones, brioche rolls) carry no prices anywhere on the menu and were dropped, as were the $3 cookie add-on and $5 'make it a deal' combo upsell (add-ons, not dishes).

Bakery per-piece prices (/usr/bin/bash.75-.70) are plausible as-is and are not a computed/markup pattern.
